description: A round platform in the pink sky, a quarter of the usual gravity, a katana each. Three seconds in, a blue fireball appears over the middle and hunts one of you; it gets faster with every reflect. Touch it and you are out. Right click brings the blade up: a fireball reflected off it flies at whoever your crosshair is nearest to. One life; the last one standing wins.
controls: SPACE  jump (low gravity: four times as high, and slow to come down)
RIGHT CLICK  reflect the fireball toward your crosshair
LEFT CLICK  switch who you watch when out
tagline: REFLECT THE FIREBALL. LAST ONE STANDING WINS
